for parameter processing and validation, allowing easier integration with other projects that rely on ParamTools, less code for the Tax-Calculator project to maintain, and other benefits for Tax-Calculator users. So, if the year is 2017, then pol.II_em returns [4050.0] instead of 4050.0. [

CPI_offset was replaced by parameter_indexing_CPI_offset, which has slightly different behavior: When parameter_indexing_CPI_offset is specified in a reform, that value is no longer added to the existing parameter_indexing_CPI_offset as was the case with CPI_offset. Rather, the specified value becomes the offset from the baseline unchained CPI. This new behavior is consistent with what is expected from all other Tax-Calculator parameters. [
